Architecture & Smart Living · House concept

Proposed house concept

TRIXX Garden Residence

A single-storey home direction focused on accessible movement, garden views and an easy connection between indoor and outdoor living.

Enquire about TRIXX Garden Residence →

The need

Why this idea matters.

Multi-level layouts can be inconvenient for households that prefer step-free circulation or want rooms to open directly to a garden.

Who it is for

Designed for a conversation with

Families, downsizers and homeowners planning for long-term accessibility and garden-centered living.

How it could work

A clear path from interest to review.

  1. 01

    Identify access, garden and household requirements.

  2. 02

    Arrange living areas around a terrace, garden and quiet bedrooms.

  3. 03

    Review circulation, levels and adaptable details against the specific site.

Proposed features

What the concept explores.

  • Single-storey layout direction
  • Open-plan kitchen, dining and living spaces
  • Direct garden and covered-terrace access
  • Optional adaptable bathrooms and circulation
  • Natural ventilation, daylight and optional smart systems

Potential benefits

What it could make easier.

  • Everyday movement can be planned on one level
  • Garden access becomes part of daily routines
  • Adaptable details can be considered before construction documents

Specifications & safeguards

Details remain subject to review.

Pricing, dimensions, technical specifications, availability and timelines are not confirmed. Device compatibility, integrations, data handling, security and professional requirements must be reviewed for the specific project before any capability is promised.
